items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Well, I had to beg Goddard, Hunter, they call him a nickname. I had to beg him to come take a job at the Levita.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was our philosophy, you know. And, uh, well, Tillman and I raised up together. His brother-in-law, you got Alan Gorda in there?
